provenance.source: SYNTHETIC test fixture - NOT real player_classlevelstats values

provenance.note: a Player has no base health; all max health comes from stamina and from item/aura modifiers
this is the create-time value; UpdateArmor recomputes armor from UNIT_MOD_ARMOR and does not re-add it

Strength.formula: ((base_flat * base_pct_exclude_create) + create) * base_pct + total_flat, then * total_pct, then int32()

Agility.formula: ((base_flat * base_pct_exclude_create) + create) * base_pct + total_flat, then * total_pct, then int32()

Stamina.formula: ((base_flat * base_pct_exclude_create) + create) * base_pct + total_flat, then * total_pct, then int32()

Intellect.formula: ((base_flat * base_pct_exclude_create) + create) * base_pct + total_flat, then * total_pct, then int32()

Spirit.formula: ((base_flat * base_pct_exclude_create) + create) * base_pct + total_flat, then * total_pct, then int32()

mastery.reason: mastery-scaled effects use SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, which carry no generic value semantics

provenance.source: SYNTHETIC test fixture - NOT real player_classlevelstats values

provenance.note: a Player has no base health; all max health comes from stamina and from item/aura modifiers
this is the create-time value; UpdateArmor recomputes armor from UNIT_MOD_ARMOR and does not re-add it
gear armor arrives in TOTAL_VALUE, so it is reported as bonus armor and is not scaled by BASE_PCT
ITEM_MOD_ATTACK_POWER and the weapon's int32(dps*6) land in TOTAL_VALUE and are reported separately as AttackPowerModPos, not folded into this number
ActivePlayerData::Mastery; each mastery effect amount is base_points + Mastery * EffectBonusCoefficient

character.caveat: Aura stages, talents, buffs, consumables and shapeshift forms are NOT applied.  Supplied contributions are explicit inputs.
